elements.name: FRESH WATER CHLORINE UNIT ALARM label

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
			mak_1_alarm__value AS fresh_water_mak1_alarm,
			mak_2_alarm__value AS fresh_water_mak2_alarm,
			chlorine_unit_alarm__value AS fresh_water_chlorine_unit_alarm
FROM public.marpower__250000_fresh_water
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'mak1_alarm' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)          AS fresh_water_mak1_alarm_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'mak2_alarm' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)          AS fresh_water_mak2_alarm_tag,
	MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'chlorine_unit_alarm' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS fresh_water_chlorine_unit_alarm_tag
FROM marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-fresh-water'

SELECT
  date_bin('$__interval', timestamp) AS time,
  MAX(mak_1_alarm__value)            AS fresh_water_mak1_alarm,
  MAX(mak_2_alarm__value)            AS fresh_water_mak2_alarm,
  MAX(chlorine_unit_alarm__value)    AS fresh_water_chlorine_unit_alarm,

WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1
